facts: The public turn/enqueue schemas at settings f3 accept optional messageSettings; client serializes each submitted input before awaiting and uses public acknowledgement validation. Existing Web outbox/queue input types do not expose messageSettings. Mounting the Picker alone therefore cannot complete this product capability.

captureMessageSettings validates the current host capability and loaded configured tuple, then returns a detached deeply frozen choice. It belongs in the synchronous submission capture before material preparation/official composer clearing.

freezeMaterialRequest only deep-freezes knowledge/attachments and freezes the outer request. Existing receipt constructors parse the complete wire object again. If messageSettings is later added, relying on the earlier capture freeze alone is insufficient: the parsed nested snapshot needs its own immutable receipt ownership.

Recovery 7cc readRecoveryDraft reconstructs an explicit field set that does not yet contain messageSettings; App draft export/restore likewise enumerates fields. Unknown additional fields are not preserved by this projection. A future host must explicitly round-trip the optional tuple or mark it unsupported, never silently strip it then send plain.

Recovery restoreOutbox reparses saved request and Queue restore passes the same freezeCommand boundary. Future nested settings immutability must therefore cover both initial receipt creation and restored receipt creation, without reselecting from a live catalog.
recommendedInterface: Keep Picker value/onChange as a presentation seam. One authenticated workspace owner holds next-draft choice by stable view key, survives split/merge/remount, and clears only by explicit user action or that same draft handoff rule. Do not add a second settings store inside Thread or plugin renderer.

Separate current-draft selection eligibility from frozen wire integrity. New submission captures against trusted live context once; an original unknown receipt retry validates its preserved schema/identity and sends original key/body, without substituting current catalog choices or silently dropping settings after capability change. Center remains authority.

Use one narrow wire-snapshot freezer after public parsing for both outbox/enqueue and their restore paths. Reuse the existing material/request boundary where semantically appropriate, but do not import the UI catalog into receipt recovery or create a second permission matcher.

Extend existing draft export/decode/restore explicitly for optional settings; retain omission versus explicit not-requested. Malformed persisted non-omitted settings must surface an error before changing the live draft. Recheck shared envelope accounting at the existing 128KiB initial / 32KiB growth / 4MiB total limits; the tuple has a public canonical 1024-byte cap, but JSON escaping and display duplication still count.
focusedFutureChecks: Actual App: synchronous A capture with delayed material preparation; user changes to B/C meanwhile; original outbound body stays A.
Send and Queue receipt getters/restored receipts: attempts to mutate profile, requested or effort cannot change retry body/hash; original request key remains identical.
Refresh/reconnect: A unknown receipt, B queued item and C next draft survive independently; original retry may report capability/profile rejection but never degrades into plain send.
Split/merge/remount, missing/current capability and catalog unavailable: retained draft selection displayed, unsafe submission blocked, explicit omission available.
Legacy saved drafts without the field stay omitted; malformed explicit field fails before partial restore; envelope over-limit keeps text/settings recoverable in current page.
coordination: This is a future integration dependency spanning current Recovery writer paths. No amendment/take or implementation authorized by this research. Manager must arrange exact scope/unique writer after current scoped leaf and Recovery safety point; shared contracts/client remain readonly.
